title: Material found buried deep in rocks at the crash site

tellings.quote: we did find things but they weren't easy to find if they were placed there they were placed so far down rocks that had been there for looked like a hundred years

plain: In 2016, at a place in New Mexico said to be the site of a UFO crash, a small group dug and found material buried far down beneath rocks, according to Diana Pasulka, a professor of religious studies who says she was there. She says they did find things, but they were not easy to find: if they had been planted, they were placed under rocks that looked like they had sat there for a hundred years. She tells it as a reason to doubt that the material was simply put there recently.
